metadata.metameric_axis_note: Legacy fallback only. New configs store the resolved per-observer 547 nm validation axis in each observer/metamer as metameric_axis.
metadata.description: 1 metamer pair per observer generated from display midpoint DISP [0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5] at proportion=0.8 of the maximal raw cone-contrast null extent. Matches the background, per-observer 547 nm axis resolution, and cone_contrast color_picking_space used by QuestColorGenerator. Generated in DISP space (RGBO), converted to BGYR for storage.
metadata.method: ColorSpace.get_cone_contrast_null_direction_in_disp(resolved_547_axis, background=DISP midpoint) with raw observer.sensor_matrix; intersected with display gamut and scaled by proportion=0.8; converted to BGYR via ColorSpace.convert()

mc_params.note: means are degree-adjusted to match nominal observer at 2 deg
